## Which file do I download?

| Your device | Download this file | Size |
|---|---|---|
| 📱 **Android phone or tablet** | **`Meditation-Android.apk`** | ~4 MB |
| 💻 **Mac with Apple chip** (M1, M2, M3, M4 — most Macs from 2021 on) | **`Meditation-Mac-AppleSilicon.dmg`** | ~2 MB |
| 💻 **Older Mac with Intel chip** | **`Meditation-Mac-Intel.dmg`** | ~2 MB |
| 🖥 **Windows 10 / 11** | **`Meditation-Windows-Setup.exe`** | ~3 MB |
| 🐧 **Linux** | **`Meditation-Linux.AppImage`** | ~80 MB |
| 🍎 **iPhone / iPad** | No download — open the [web app](https://thrishankkuntimaddi.github.io/Meditation/) in Safari → Share → **Add to Home Screen** | — |

Not sure which Mac you have?  → Apple menu → **About This Mac**. "Chip: Apple M…" means Apple chip; "Processor: Intel" means Intel.

*"Source code (zip)" and "Source code (tar.gz)" are added by GitHub automatically — you don't need them.*

## How to install

**Android**
1. Download `Meditation-Android.apk` on your phone and tap it.
2. If asked, allow your browser to *install unknown apps*. Chrome may say the file "can harm your device" — it says this for every app that doesn't come from the Play Store.
3. Open Meditation → tap **Allow** on the "silence your phone" card so it can turn on Do Not Disturb during sessions.

**Mac**
1. Open the `.dmg` and drag **Meditation** into **Applications**.
2. Open it. macOS will say it "can't be verified" because the app isn't registered with Apple (that costs $99/year).
3. Go to **System Settings → Privacy & Security**, scroll down, and click **Open Anyway** next to Meditation. You only do this once.

**Windows**
1. Run `Meditation-Windows-Setup.exe`.
2. If "Windows protected your PC" appears, click **More info → Run anyway** (shown for apps without a paid code-signing certificate). You only do this once.

The app lives in the menu bar / system tray after you close its window, so reminders and silencing keep working. Turn on **Profile → Open at login** to have it start with your computer.
